name: Rideshare slot
description: Your CubeSat rides along with a bigger satellite. Very cheap, but only to low Earth orbit and only for tiny spacecraft.

name: Small launcher
description: A dedicated small rocket. Takes a few hundred kilograms to Earth orbit and a very light probe towards the Moon.

name: Medium launcher
description: A workhorse rocket. Can send a medium spacecraft to the Moon or a light one to Mars.

name: Heavy launcher
description: A large rocket for heavy deep-space missions. Expensive, but it opens up big Mars orbiters.

name: Super-heavy launcher
description: The biggest rocket class. Huge capacity at a huge price: rarely the efficient choice for one science spacecraft.
